# Cuprice MCP Server — Full Reference

> Manage Cuprice pricing projects from AI tools via Model Context Protocol.

Endpoint: POST https://mcp.cuprice.io/mcp
Docs: https://docs.cuprice.io/mcp
Website: https://cuprice.io

---

## What is Cuprice?

Cuprice lets you build feature-based pricing pages and embed them on any website. Users can pick a plan, customize features, and pay via Stripe — all without leaving your site.

## What is this MCP server?

This server exposes Cuprice's functionality as MCP tools that AI assistants (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code) can call. You can create projects, add features, build plans, publish, and get embed code — all through natural language.

## Setup

### Remote (no install)

Add to `.cursor/mcp.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "cuprice": {
      "url": "https://mcp.cuprice.io/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

### Local (with auth)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/eynullabeyli/cuprice-mcp.git
cd cuprice-mcp && npm install && npm run build
```

Add to `.cursor/mcp.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "cuprice": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/path/to/cuprice-mcp/dist/index.js"],
      "env": {
        "CUPRICE_BASE": "https://cuprice.io",
        "CUPRICE_AUTH_TOKEN": "your-session-token"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

---

## Tools Reference

### list-projects

List all your Cuprice pricing projects.

**Input:** none

**Output:** Array of projects with id, name, slug, shareId, currency, plan count, feature count.

---

### get-project

Get full details of a project including plans, features, and theme settings.

**Input:**
- `slug` (string, required) — Project slug or numeric ID

**Output:** Full project object with all plans, features, theme settings, and configuration.

---

### get-shared-project

Get public pricing data for a shared project. No authentication needed.

**Input:**
- `shareId` (string, required) — The project's Share ID

**Output:** Public project data including plans with features, pricing, and theme.

---

### create-project

Create a new Cuprice pricing project.

**Input:**
- `name` (string, required) — Project name
- `description` (string, optional) — Short description
- `pricingPageDescription` (string, optional) — Description shown on the pricing page header
- `currency` (string, optional) — Currency code, default "USD"

**Output:** Created project object.

---

### update-project

Update a project's settings.

**Input:**
- `slug` (string, required) — Project slug or numeric ID
- `name` (string, optional) — New name
- `description` (string, optional) — New description
- `pricingPageDescription` (string, optional) — New pricing page description
- `currency` (string, optional) — Currency code
- `annualDiscount` (number, optional) — Annual discount, e.g. 0.2 = 20%
- `annualDiscountEnabled` (boolean, optional) — Enable annual billing toggle
- `checkoutSuccessUrl` (string, optional) — Redirect URL after successful payment
- `checkoutCancelUrl` (string, optional) — Redirect URL after cancelled payment

**Output:** Updated project object.

---

### add-feature

Add a feature to a project's backlog.

**Input:**
- `projectId` (number, required) — Project ID
- `name` (string, required) — Feature name
- `description` (string, optional) — Feature description
- `featureType` (string, optional) — "Standart", "Limits", or "Usage Based"
- `basePrice` (number, optional) — Base price
- `isCountable` (boolean, optional) — Is this a countable feature

**Output:** Created feature object.

---

### create-plan

Create a new pricing plan in a project.

**Input:**
- `projectId` (number, required) — Project ID
- `name` (string, required) — Plan name (e.g. "Pro")
- `description` (string, optional) — Plan description
- `order` (number, optional) — Display order (0-based)
- `isPopular` (boolean, optional) — Show "Most Popular" badge

**Output:** Created plan object.

---

### add-feature-to-plan

Add a feature from the backlog to a pricing plan.

**Input:**
- `projectId` (number, required) — Project ID
- `featureId` (number, required) — Feature ID to add
- `planId` (number, required) — Plan ID to add the feature to

**Output:** Success confirmation with feature details.

---

### publish-project

Publish a project to generate a Share ID for embedding.

**Input:**
- `projectId` (number, required) — Project ID

**Output:** Object with shareId.

---

### get-embed-code

Get the HTML/React/Next.js embed snippet for a published project.

**Input:**
- `shareId` (string, required) — The project's Share ID
- `framework` (string, optional) — "html", "nextjs", or "react". Default: "html"

**Output:** Ready-to-use code snippet for the specified framework.

---

### get-receipt

Get purchase details from a Stripe checkout session.

**Input:**
- `sessionId` (string, required) — Stripe Checkout session ID
- `shareId` (string, required) — Project Share ID

**Output:** Receipt with planName, features purchased, total, currency, customer email, billing interval, subscription ID, and metadata.

---

## Cuprice API Endpoints (used internally)

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| GET | /api/share/{shareId} | Get public project data |
| GET | /api/stripe/receipt?session_id=...&shareId=... | Get purchase details |
| POST | /api/stripe/checkout | Create checkout for a regular plan |
| POST | /api/stripe/checkout/custom | Create checkout for a custom plan |
| GET | /api/projects | List all projects (auth required) |
| GET | /api/projects/{slug} | Get project details (auth required) |
| POST | /api/projects | Create project (auth required) |
| PUT | /api/projects/{slug} | Update project (auth required) |
| POST | /api/projects/{id}/backlog | Add feature (auth required) |
| POST | /api/projects/{id}/plans | Create plan (auth required) |
| POST | /api/projects/{id}/backlog/{featureId}/move | Add feature to plan (auth required) |
| POST | /api/projects/{id}/publish | Publish project (auth required) |

## Embed Widget

Add to any HTML page:

```html
<div data-cuprice-id="YOUR_SHARE_ID"></div>
<script src="https://cuprice.io/embed.js" async></script>
```

## Feature Gating

After Stripe checkout, the success URL receives a `session_id`. Call the receipt API to get which features were purchased:

- **Regular plans:** Receipt metadata contains `planId`. Look up features via Share API.
- **Custom plans:** Receipt metadata contains `featureDetails_0`, `featureDetails_1`, etc. Join and parse as JSON to get feature names.

## CSS Customization

Target elements with `cuprice-` prefixed class names:

- `.cuprice-pricing-card` — Plan cards
- `.cuprice-pricing-button` — "Choose Plan" buttons
- `.cuprice-pricing-badge` — "Most Popular" badge
- `.cuprice-billing-toggle` — Monthly/Annual toggle
- `.cuprice-custom-plan-card` — Custom plan card
- `.cuprice-custom-plan-button` — "Create Now" button
